_commentOriginalPrice: Installation cost. No adjustment for solar used to charge the car: the EV charger (Indra, beyond the CT) is now modelled directly via evCharging, which counts PV that charged the car as self-consumed.
_commentEvBasisFrom: Second EV from May 2026: project EV charging at the level seen since then

evSavings._comment: EV vs petrol (the app's EV tab): a 50 mpg petrol car; the EVs' 3.9 miles/kWh at 90% AC charging efficiency. beforeCharger = charging the Indra charger never saw, from OVO Charge Anytime credits (credit / (flat rate - 6.67p ex VAT)), at the 7p Charge Anytime rate. credits = one-off EV credits (£ inc VAT), taken off that month's charging cost.

credits.note: OVO Beyond 2000 free miles (EV charger): -33.25 ex VAT

exportCorrection._comment: Calibrated vs Fuse smart meter 7 Aug-30 Sep 2026: inverter CT over-reads export ~4.7% (gain); EV charger standby ~11 W while exporting, charger off 6-25 Aug

pvCheck._comment: Weather-normalised PV health check (analysis/pvcheck.py). Orientation fitted from Jun-Oct 2025 data; site latitude/longitude live in git-ignored config.local.json.
